title: BiasConnect: Investigating Bias Interactions in Text-to-Image Models
findings: For the prompt 'An elephant getting married in Indian traditions,' the analysis showed a bias interaction where 'Modern aesthetics' were associated with generated images of Christian weddings, while 'Traditional or natural aesthetics' were associated with weddings from South-Asian religions, indicating a stereotypical link between aesthetics and religious traditions.
